summary.text: Kristin Bahner is a Democratic state representative from Minnesota House District 37B who has served in the Minnesota House since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Kristin Bahner's tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2019, and her current term ends on January 12, 2027.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Education Finance, Health Finance and Policy, and State Government Finance and Policy committees, and she is co-vice chair of the State Government Finance and Policy Committee.
The Democratic primary for her seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
